text:
incident-bot: Pager -> HIGH queue depth on gpu-pool-east, HPA custom metric 'llm_queue_depth' >= 120 for 3m, p99 latency -> 8.2s. Auto-scale attempted but pods pending. Paging eng-oncall. https://dash.redwood.example.com/d/gpu/pool-east

alex: Taking this. Saw the alert. Marking as active pager. @mira you on rotation for warmup?

mira: On it. Joining. Quick ask: which customers reporting errors? I see error spike in frontend logs -> 502s and `upstream read timeout` around the same window.

devon: Confirmed customer-facing 502s for some routes. Ingress logs show backend connection queueing. Queue depth metric per-model shows model-x-large queue depth 95 -> 140 within the window.

alex: Timeline I'm assembling: 12:03:12 - traffic ramp (deploy?), 12:04:05 - HPA fired scale, 12:06:50 - pods pending, 12:10:00 - p99 latency > 5s, 12:12:30 - paging. Need pod events and node/gpu pool state.

tasha: kubectl describe hpa/model-x-large-prod -> `currentMetrics: {queue_depth 140}, desiredReplicas: 12, currentReplicas: 4`

mira: kubectl get pods -n inference --field-selector=status.phase=Pending -> many pending with reason=PodScheduled? No, reason=FailedScheduling? Actually events show `0/12 nodes available: Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu.`

devon: GPU pool metrics: aws-asg/gpu-pool-east at max-size=12 and currently 12 nodes active. Cluster autoscaler logged `NoScale: quotaExceeded` around 12:05. Looks like cloud quota prevented new nodes.

ryan: Adding logs: container warmup logs show repeated timeouts contacting model store during startup: 
```
[12:04:40] warmup: shard-3 load start
[12:05:08] warmup: shard-3 download failed: http 504 from s3-edge
[12:05:20] warmup: retrying (attempt 2)
[12:05:42] warmup: shard-3 load start
[12:06:15] warmup: shard-3 load complete (slow) total=95s
[12:06:33] init: model ready
```
So warmup was very slow (~95s) for some shards which pushed pods past our latency SLO.

alex: Hypotheses (tracking):
1) Primary: Cloud quota prevented ASG scale -> HPA desired > capacity -> pods pending -> increased queue depth.
2) Secondary: Slow model shard warmup (S3 504s) amplified outage by keeping pods unready longer.
3) Tertiary: Batching/backpressure logic didn't kick in early enough (queue thresholds conservative).

mira: Evidence for #1: ASG at max-size + autoscaler events show quotaExceeded. Evidence for #2: warmup 504s in logs. Evidence for #3: queue-depth alarm threshold was 150, but model-specific queue hit 140 earlier and per-route started timing out.

devon: Live mitigation suggestions: (A) Temporarily set ASG max-size +3 to allow nodes if quota cleared (request sent to infra billing), (B) evict low-priority batch jobs from pool, (C) enable fallback model variant (smaller) routing for affected customers, (D) lower batch size / reduce max queued requests per-instance to force earlier scale decisions.

alex: Actioning: @ryan can you open quota increase with cloud infra (I've DM'd billing). @tasha can you kick fallback routing for model-x-large -> model-x-medium for high-latency customers? mira and devon try evicting batch pods and check if pending pods start running.

tasha: Kicking routing via feature-flag: `ffctl set rollback model-x-large.fallback enabled` -> applied to prod routing for customer segments A,B. Watching impact.

mira: Evicted 18 low-priority jobs from gpu-pool-east (pod eviction drain). After evict, cluster reported 5 pending pods scheduled -> 3 moved to Running by 12:18. p99 down from 8.2s to 3.1s.

devon: Confirmed ASG remains at max (12). Pods moved into running because we had drained batch and freed GPUs. CPU/gpu utilization rose to 92% on those nodes. Warmup still slow for 2 pods but fallback routing prevented further customer impact.

alex: Customer impact note for postmortem: Customers X and Y saw 502s from ~12:10 -> 12:25 (approx). Mitigation sequence: evict batch jobs (12:15), enable fallback routing (12:16), running pods catch up (12:18), latency stabilized (12:24).

ryan: For RCA doc: capturing these action items -> cloud quota increase ticket #INC-4572, adjust ASG safety buffer, reduce warmup fragility (pre-warmed images / shard parallelism), tweak queue threshold and backpressure. Also add alerting for `ASG at max-size && HPA desired > current` as a predictive pager.

srebot: Note added to incident log: incident-type=capacity+warmup, severity=sev2, start=2612349999, mitigation=evict-batch+fallback-routing, owner=alex.

alex: Next steps assigned:
- infra/cloud: follow up on quota (ryan)
- runtime: add pre-warm options for shard download and increase parallelism (mira)
- platform: add predictive ASG max-size alert and reduce conservative queue threshold (devon)
- product/CS: prepare customer comms for X/Y and note SLAs (tasha)

mira: I'll collect the warmup logs + S3 edge traces and put them in the RCA doc. Putting draft timeline into /docs/incidents/2612349999-autoscale-queue-dive.md

alex: Thanks all, handing off to postmortem owners. I'll leave this thread open for any follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
